source: What Is a Question Worth?, 12 November 2026; views revision 13 November 2026
status: Fictional case inputs from the essay; not physical observations or an app import file.
heavy_marble_rule: Exactly one heavy marble across all nine marbles.
reliability: At most one incorrect result in the whole run, not per comparison; no error probabilities assumed.
illustrative_fallback_permission: The decision owner permits an immediate hold of the handoff if identification is unresolved. This is an added illustrative operating rule.

phrase_bindings.decision_question: Which bag should we hold at the handoff?
phrase_bindings.evidence_plan: Prepare and sort; compare red with blue three times; record each report; interpret the majority using the one-error rule.
phrase_bindings.evidence_condition: A nonempty compatible explanation set under the global one-error rule, with the same containing bag b in every remaining explanation.
phrase_bindings.supported_action: Choose identified bag b; allow one minute to complete the choice.
phrase_bindings.fallback_action: Hold the handoff and record unresolved identification for review, under the added permission.
phrase_bindings.usable_evidence_deadline: Minute 11 after the case minute-0 start, reserving one minute for choice before minute 12.
phrase_bindings.learning_plan_cost: 3 resource credits for three physical weighings; other scheduled work is unpriced; no monetary acquisition-cost estimate supplied.

variations: Select Reliable reports: no incorrect result, update and preview; then restore the one-error bound.
Change only the commitment deadline from minute 12 to minute 10, update and preview; then restore minute 12.
